4128456639.source: Makes your character immune to all damage.
4128456639.text: 使你的角色免疫所有伤害。

525024608.source: Heals your ped to full health every frame.
525024608.text: 时刻让你保持满血状态，但受到即死伤害仍会死亡

638344572.source: Refills your character's armor and restocks all inventory armor slots.
638344572.text: 补满角色的护甲，并填满库存中的所有护甲槽位。

2658732694.source: Restocks all snacks in your inventory to their maximum value.

3523454436.source: Changes how fast you regenerate health.
3523454436.text: 改变你恢复生命值的速度。

3954294902.source: Resurrects your ped immediately when dying.
3954294902.text: 死亡时立即复活你的 玩家实体。

3565731681.source: The Bullshark Testosterone Effect increases your health, your strength and your bullet damage.
3565731681.text: 牛鲨睾酮会增幅你的生命值、力量和子弹伤害。

893162536.source: Off the Radar makes your player blip vanish from the map. Other players will not be able to find you on it.
893162536.text: “人间蒸发”会让你的玩家图标从地图上消失。其他玩家将无法在地图上找到你。

390440919.source: Reveals all players on the map that are currently Off the Radar.
390440919.text: 显示地图上当前不在雷达范围内的所有玩家。

3145340696.source: Cops Turn Blind Eye makes cops ignore all crimes you commit while the effect is active.
3145340696.text: 使警察忽略你犯下的所有罪行。

1376934617.source: Thermal Vision lets you see heat signatures.
1376934617.text: 像红外热感仪一般的视野。让你轻易的发现每一个生物

1082739767.source: Night Vision lets you see in the dark.
1082739767.text: 夜视仪让你在黑暗中也能更清晰的看见东西。

1093460158.source: Disables the cam adjustment when colliding with an entity.
1093460158.text: 当与实体碰撞时，禁用游戏镜头的调整。

3046592389.source: Prevents stunt jumps from changing your camera.
3046592389.text: 阻止飞车特技改变你的视角。

1242937699.source: This will make your game's camera look like GTA 1.
1242937699.text: 这将使你的游戏的相机看起来像 GTA 1。

1834134266.source: Disables the wanted system for yourself.

11842258.source: Locks your wanted level at 5 stars.
11842258.text: 将你的通缉等级锁定在 5 颗星。

4003979888.source: The ultimate police chase. All of Los Santos will be locked down and you will face a lot of different police vehicles.
4003979888.text: 你将获得6星通缉并面临洛圣都警察的全城追捕。整个洛圣都将被警察封锁，你将面对许多不同的警车追捕。

2663848349.text: 设置仅用于显示的通缉等级。

3862336303.source: You will never run out of special ability.
3862336303.text: 你永远不会用完特殊能力。

2341957805.text: 车内第一人称视角调整

1463993339.text: 第三人称瞄准视角调整

2429067859.source: Third Person In Vehicle Aim FOV
2429067859.text: 车内第三人称瞄准视角调整

1898943071.text: 电影及特技镜头视角调整

3175650608.source: Cinematic FOV is used for the Cinematic Vehicle Cam, the Stunt Jump Cam or the Idle Cam.

2211315589.source: Scripted FOV is used for things like the Orbital Cannon, pressing R to focus on Points of Interest or in gameplay to zoom in on stuff.
2211315589.text: 脚本视角用于天基炮、按 R 聚焦，兴趣点或在游戏中放大东西等。

2568867155.source: Makes you able to fly around in noclip. Once disabled you will return to your ped's position.
2568867155.text: 让你能够在穿墙模式下四处飞行。一旦禁用，你将返回角色的位置。

3567800255.source: Makes you able to fly around with your ped in noclip.
3567800255.text: 让你能够无阻碍的四处飞行。

1062977797.text: 自由镜头车辆保持速度

3988838587.source: Keeps the forward speed of a vehicle from before noclip and applies it again when disabled.
3988838587.text: 保留载具进入穿墙模式前的前进速度，并在禁用时重新应用。

630630652.source: Replaces Speed while you are inside an interior.
630630652.text: 当你身处室内时代替“速度”。

3844709262.source: Replaces Speed Fast while you are inside an interior.
3844709262.text: 当你身处室内时代替“快速速度”。

627787209.source: Replaces Speed Vertical while you are inside an interior.
627787209.text: 当你身处室内时代替“垂直速度”。

2697126539.source: Move vehicles, peds and objects like the Hulk.
2697126539.text: 像浩克一样穿过车辆或者实体

1820723580.source: Disables collision with all other vehicles.

2877434237.source: Disables collision with all other peds.

4270076866.source: Disables collision with all kinds of objects.
4270076866.text: 禁用与各类物体的碰撞。

4230816674.source: Disables collision with walls and buildings.
4230816674.text: 禁用一些墙体的碰撞(房屋建筑除外)

846124686.source: Allows you to run and jump inside interiors like the casino and Kosatka.
846124686.text: 允许你在赌场和虎鲸潜艇等室内区域奔跑和跳跃。

3172541187.source: When walking off of an edge you will be able to walk on without falling down.
3172541187.text: 当走出边缘时，你将能够继续行走而不会摔倒。

1041776426.source: Makes you able to walk under water.

2549206222.source: Makes you able to walk over water.
2549206222.text: 让你能够在水面上行走。

1431304415.source: Changes how fast your character will try to run. Setting this too high will result in some Looney Tunes-like running.
1431304415.text: 调整角色尝试奔跑的速度。设置过高会出现类似《乐一通》的滑稽跑步动作。

2483897808.source: Changes how fast your character will swim.
2483897808.text: 改变你的角色游泳的速度。

303967757.source: Makes your character unable to roll over or fall to the ground.
303967757.text: 使你的角色无法翻滚或摔倒在地。

905934859.source: Makes you able to fly around like Superman.
905934859.text: 让你能够像超人一样飞来飞去。

2980983716.source: Puts you high up into the air with a parachute.
2980983716.text: 用降落伞把你带到高空。

939784422.source: Only syncs modifications to other players from -1 to 1.
939784422.text: 仅会将范围在 -1 到 1 之间的修改同步给其他玩家。

2847204340.source: Allows for normally disallowed outfits to be stored using the in-game outfit slots which are accessible through clothing stores around the map.
2847204340.text: 允许使用地图各处服装店内的游戏套装栏位，来保存通常被禁用的服装。

3410702296.source: Allows you to freely use your wardrobe or clothing shops to put together disallowed outfits. For example you can wear a dress and pants at the same time, which would normally only be applicable through glitches or mod menus.
3410702296.text: 允许你自由使用衣柜或服装店来搭配通常不允许的服装。例如，你可以同时穿裙子和裤子，通常只有利用漏洞或修改器菜单才能做到。

4291197112.source: Changes your character's width, thickness and height. Only you can see these changes.
4291197112.text: 更改角色的宽度、厚度和高度。只有您可以看到这些变化。

1131939323.source: Shrinks your ped to half of its original size.
1131939323.text: 将你的 玩家实体 缩小到原始大小的一半。

1876526818.text: 坐在设施长椅上喝东西

185824123.text: 坐在设施长椅上吃东西

2972184231.text: 医护人员宣告死亡时间

3753840282.text: 设置武器武器握持方式

967508725.text: 设置你的武器握持方式。

3419169314.source: Makes your character jack cars like Michael, Franklin or Trevor, with story mode's armed jacks when you hold a gun. Other players see them when you jack an NPC.
3419169314.text: 让你的角色像麦克、富兰克林或崔佛那样抢车，持枪时还会使用故事模式的持枪抢车动作。当你抢夺 NPC 的车辆时，其他玩家也能看到这些动作。

3869929186.source: Makes your character jack cars like Michael, Franklin and Trevor in turn, in a shuffled order.
3869929186.text: 让你的角色以随机乱序轮流使用麦克、富兰克林和崔佛的动作抢车。

3057884318.source: Clone the player's ped and spawn it next to them.
3057884318.text: 克隆该玩家的角色并在其身旁生成。

68209203.source: Spawn an exact copy of the player's vehicle.
68209203.text: 生成该玩家载具的完全复制品。

2958792701.source: Adds the player to the list of saved players.
2958792701.text: 将玩家添加到保存的玩家列表中

2838420221.source: Copy the Rockstar ID of the selected player to your clipboard.
2838420221.text: 将所选玩家的 Rockstar ID 复制到剪贴板。

478740678.source: If another Cherax user has loaded the same DLC model as you, it will automatically sync the same model which you see. If another player does not have the same DLC model loaded, they will see a legit model instead of the custom one. If you enable this, it will force the same model you have to sync to their machine.
478740678.text: 如果另一名 Cherax 用户加载了与你相同的 DLC 模型，系统将自动同步你所看到的相同模型。如果其他玩家未加载相同的 DLC 模型，他们将看到正常的游戏模型而非自定义模型。若启用此项，将强制把你的模型同步至他们的机器上。

952945961.source: Hides all players in the session from the player. They will not be able to see anyone.
952945961.text: 对该玩家隐藏战局中的所有玩家。他们将无法看到任何人。

1050732371.source: Hides the player ped from everyone besides you.
1050732371.text: 向除你以外的所有人隐藏该玩家的角色。

4214327806.source: Hides the player ped locally and only for you. It automatically reappears when you are near enough after disabling this feature.
4214327806.text: 仅在你的本地隐藏该玩家的角色。禁用此功能后，当你靠得足够近时，该角色会自动重新出现。

73210667.source: Makes the player have a black screen.

1947610419.source: Kicks the player from their current Organization/Motorcycle Club.
1947610419.text: 将玩家从其当前的组织或摩托帮中踢出。

1572128560.source: Teleport to the selected player's waypoint.
1572128560.text: 传送到所选玩家的路径点。

3170312990.source: Sends the player to your waypoint, if you have one.
3170312990.text: 将玩家发送到你的路径点（如果有的话）。

1881908510.source: Sends the player to their waypoint, if they have one.
1881908510.text: 将玩家发送到他们的路径点（如果有的话）。

2320716298.source: Sends the player to the abandoned mines.

401418637.source: Sends the player to the top of Mt. Chilliad.

2188313905.source: Sends the player to the top of the Maze Bank building.
2188313905.text: 将玩家发送到花园银行大楼的顶部。

3143773388.source: Sends the player to a secret laboratory.
3143773388.text: 将玩家送往秘密实验室。

384744190.source: Sends the player to a dark room.
384744190.text: 将玩家发送到一个黑暗的房间。

89820665.source: Give the player full health and armor.
89820665.text: 给予玩家完整的生命值和护甲。

3935896502.source: Only works when the target player has unlocked Ballistic Armor.
3935896502.text: 仅当目标玩家解锁了弹道装甲时才有效。

4018237476.source: Gives the player ammo for their current weapon.
4018237476.text: 为玩家提供当前武器的弹药。

2506262989.source: Unlocks the "Trust No One" torso tattoo for the player.
2506262989.text: 为玩家解锁“不相信任何人”躯干纹身。

4066078262.source: Turns the player into an animal during Halloween.
4066078262.text: 在万圣节期间将该玩家变成动物。

715390672.source: Puts the player into the back of a stockade van that drives around randomly.
715390672.text: 将玩家放入一辆随机行驶的 stockade 厢式货车后舱。

1683344389.source: Ram the player with a random vehicle.

1660126089.source: Spawn a random hostile and armed ped near the player.
1660126089.text: 在玩家附近随机生成一个敌对且武装的 NPC。

3318201341.source: Spawn a hostile Jesus armed with a railgun near the player.
3318201341.text: 在玩家附近生成一个手持电磁步枪的敌对耶稣。

3693665338.source: Spawn a random bodyguard ped near the player.
3693665338.text: 在玩家附近生成一个随机保镖。

943255808.source: Removes the player's yee-yee ass haircut, making them get them some bitches on their dick.
943255808.text: 去掉玩家那傻逼发型，让他们也能勾到几个婊子上床。

3124640914.source: Shoots several rockets towards the player.

3418513901.source: Traps the player in the selected cage.
3418513901.text: 将玩家困在选定的笼子里。

1302311589.source: Set an anonymous remote bounty of 9k on the player.
1302311589.text: 对玩家设置 9k 的匿名远程悬赏

2936574136.source: Kicks the player from their current seat and will keep blocking it for everyone except you.
2936574136.text: 将该玩家从当前座位踢出，并持续阻止除你之外的任何人使用该座位。

2796356260.source: Kicks the player out of their vehicle.

3850099434.source: Deletes the player's current vehicle for everyone in the session.
3850099434.text: 在整个战局中删除该玩家当前的载具。

4065482458.source: Blow the player's vehicle engine up.

2452689089.source: Set the player's vehicle tires on fire.

3931070831.source: Break off the player's vehicle wheels.
3931070831.text: 使玩家载具的车轮脱落。

3273698510.source: Break off the player's vehicle doors.
3273698510.text: 使玩家载具的车门脱落。

3009964242.text: 打开该玩家的载具车门。

1611298655.text: 关闭该玩家的载具车门。

3853628844.source: Adds a ramp in front of the player's vehicle.
3853628844.text: 在玩家车辆前面添加一个坡道。

1685150785.source: The value representing a multiplier of the vehicle's current top speed.
1685150785.text: 代表车辆当前最高速度倍数的数值。

3591598970.source: Removes the player from your session using the best-suited kick method.
3591598970.text: 使用最合适的踢出方式将该玩家从你的战局中踢出。

3706898394.source: Removes the player from your session.
3706898394.text: 将玩家从你的战局中移除。

74331804.source: Kicks the player from the session using a script event.
74331804.text: 使用脚本事件将玩家从会话中踢出。

1306077894.source: Only works when session host. Removes the player from your session.
1306077894.text: 仅当你是战局主机时有效。将玩家从你的战局中移除。

871864113.source: Adds the player to saved players and enables block join. After that the player will be kicked.
871864113.text: 将玩家添加到已保存的玩家中并启用阻止加入。之后该玩家将被踢出。

3673787850.source: Send the player to an infinite loading screen.
3673787850.text: 使玩家进入无限加载画面。

3635888998.source: Explodes the player as if they were hit by an orbital strike.
3635888998.text: 引爆该玩家，效果如同被天基炮命中。

781307661.source: Block incoming entity syncs from a specific player.
781307661.text: 阻止来自特定玩家的传入实体同步

3182672795.source: Block outgoing entity syncs to a specific player.
3182672795.text: 阻止传出实体同步到特定玩家

898755470.source: Block incoming script events from a specific player.
898755470.text: 阻止来自特定玩家的传入脚本事件

856882877.source: Block outgoing script events to a specific player.
856882877.text: 阻止向特定玩家发送的脚本事件。

676140453.source: Starts a raid on one of the player's MC businesses.
676140453.text: 对玩家的一处摩托帮产业发起突袭。

636206938.source: Start a raid on the player's bunker.

1705808078.source: Choose a map to be used for the player position map.
1705808078.text: 选择用于玩家位置图的地图。

4247314002.text: 玩家游戏帐户所在的平台ID

4103611601.text: 离开 GTA 在线模式

917184333.source: Restarts freemode and the scripts that run under it, like a session change that keeps you in this session.

1692082512.source: Leaves this session and joins it again right away, without a loading screen or the sky camera.
1692082512.text: 离开当前战局并立即重新加入，无需经过加载界面或云层视角。

4115724974.source: Automatically runs Seamless Rejoin after the specified time. This is primarily used to avoid the BattlEye kick that happens after a certain amount of time when a BattlEye host detects a non-BattlEye player in their session. The timer restarts when the session host changes.
4115724974.text: 在指定时间后自动执行“无缝重新加入”。这主要用于避免 BattlEye 主机在战局中检测到非 BattlEye 玩家并在一段时间后触发的 BattlEye 踢出。计时器会在战局主机发生变更时重新开始。

2094999927.source: Makes everyone who tries to join you join the session of the targeted Rockstar ID.
2094999927.text: 让所有尝试加入你的玩家转而加入目标 Rockstar ID 所在的战局。

3842570106.source: Stops the matchmaking services from promoting your session to random GTA Online joiners.
3842570106.text: 阻止配对服务将随机 GTA:Online 加入者放入您的会话中。

2822219617.source: Advertises your session to the matchmaking services, making people more likely to join your session.
2822219617.text: 宣传您的战局，让你的战局更容易进入玩家

2269959258.source: Advertise your session as being in a different region, so players searching that region find it.
2269959258.text: 将你的战局广播为位于其他区域，以便在该区域搜索的玩家能找到它。

1634545702.source: Makes you join sessions much faster, but can break some things. For example, you might lose your weapons upon a session change.
1634545702.text: 让你更快地加入会话，但可能会破坏一些东西。例如，你可能会在战局更改时丢失武器（暂时丢失）。

2225486259.text: 打字时 允许使用粘贴

2215026371.source: This allows you to paste up to 140 chars into chat.
2215026371.text: 允许你将最多 140 个字符粘贴到聊天中。

102814587.source: Press tab in chat to auto complete and iterate over all player names.
102814587.text: 在聊天中按 Tab 键可自动补全玩家名称，并依次切换所有玩家的名称。

2124262490.source: Allows you to use special characters in chat like '<' or 'N-ary summation' for the R* logo and many more.
2124262490.text: 允许你在聊天中使用特殊字符，例如代表 R* 标志的“<”或“求和符号”等。

2926087938.source: This will visually mute the text chat. However, you will still be able to see chat messages in the Cherax console.
2926087938.text: 在画面中隐藏文字聊天。不过，你仍能在 Cherax 控制台查看聊天消息。

125142855.source: Change the region the game searches when it looks for a session. Any drops the region constraint entirely.
125142855.text: 更改游戏搜索战局时查询的区域。“任意”将完全取消区域限制。

352064883.source: Drop sessions below this player count from the game's own search. Falls back to the fullest sessions on offer when none reach it.
352064883.text: 从游戏自身的搜索结果中排除玩家人数低于此阈值的战局。若没有战局达到要求，则选择可用战局中玩家最多的战局。

4018869517.source: Used to find sessions with the same asset hash.
4018869517.text: 用于查找具有相同资产哈希的会话。

329910818.source: Use this if you get errors due to an invalid asset hash or only get into empty sessions when joining other sessions.
329910818.text: 如果你在加入其他战局时因资产哈希无效而出错，或只能进入空战局，请使用此功能。

248171303.source: Sets you in a "subsession", where only players in the same "subsession" can interact with you.
248171303.text: 将你置于一个“子战局”，只有处于同一“子战局”的玩家才能与你互动。

2318030304.source: Skip confirmation alerts when joining a different session.
2318030304.text: 加入不同战局时跳过确认提醒信息

3531844579.text: 自动强制获取脚本主机权限。

3592752209.source: Bail from the session as if you had desynced.
3592752209.text: 以发生网络不同步时的方式退出战局。

3488648411.source: Bail from the session and go into story mode.
3488648411.text: 退出会话并进入故事模式。

2156874873.source: If you get stuck in the clouds or somewhere else and neither of the other bail options works, try this.
2156874873.text: 如果你卡在云层中或其他地方，且其他退出选项均无效，请尝试此选项。

3273125580.text: 将自己排除在多个选项之外。

2019666246.text: 从多个选项中排除好友。

3176006828.source: Exclude other players from several options.
3176006828.text: 从多个选项中排除其他玩家。

2557026383.source: Shows players who are using invisibility, allowing you to see them even when they're hidden.

510083527.source: Clears the wanted level of all players.
510083527.text: 清除所有玩家的通缉等级。

3659144759.source: Trap all players in the selected cage.
3659144759.text: 将所有玩家困在选定的牢笼中。

1981980059.source: Kick a random player from your session.
1981980059.text: 从你的会话中随机踢出一名玩家。

1094617223.source: Kick all players from your session using a simple kick.
1094617223.text: 使用简单踢出方式将所有玩家踢出你的战局。

3320588614.source: Crash all players in the session.
3320588614.text: 使战局中所有玩家的游戏崩溃。

3543553489.source: Sends all players to your waypoint, if you have one.
3543553489.text: 将所有玩家传送到你的导航点（若有）。

626070578.text: 全部发送到秘密实验室

1459201191.source: Sends all players to a secret laboratory.
1459201191.text: 将所有玩家传送到秘密实验室。

4156495396.source: Sends all players to a dark room.
4156495396.text: 将所有玩家传送到小黑屋。

971862175.source: Sends all players to the top of the Maze Bank building.
971862175.text: 将所有玩家传送到花园银行大楼楼顶。

430972342.source: Sends all players to the top of Mount Chiliad.
430972342.text: 将所有玩家传送到乞力耶德山顶。

740034796.source: Sends all players to the abandoned mines.
740034796.text: 将所有玩家传送到废弃矿井。

2640405321.text: 将所有玩家传送到天堂。

1238734546.source: Other players will be unable to vote kick you. Most menus will flag you as a modder for spoofing this.
1238734546.text: 其他玩家将无法投票踢出你。大多数菜单会因伪造此项而将你标记为作弊者。

828812507.source: Other players will be unable to vote kick you. Most menus will flag you as a modder for spoofing this.
828812507.text: 其他玩家将无法投票踢出你。大多数菜单会因伪造此项而将你标记为作弊者。

2548451597.source: Will spoof that you are in a cheater pool.
2548451597.text: 会欺骗说您在作弊池中

3822691345.source: Spoof your game language for other players.
3822691345.text: 模仿其他玩家的游戏语言

2170562738.source: Select the language that will be spoofed to other players.

524214072.source: Other players will be unable to see you on the map or in the player list.
524214072.text: 其他玩家将无法在地图上或玩家列表中看到你

768171019.source: Note: Other players might appear under the map.
768171019.text: 注意：其他玩家可能会出现在地图下。

1349858233.source: Looks like you would lag for other players. Specify the amount of player syncs that should be lost.
1349858233.text: 让其他玩家看来你处于卡顿状态。指定应当丢弃的玩家同步数量。

132624240.source: Spinbot for the local player ped.
132624240.text: 本地玩家角色的自动旋转功能。

3441033758.source: Spinbot for the local player vehicle.

2895407763.source: Spoof your position for other players.
2895407763.text: 向其他玩家伪装你的位置。

1282793785.source: Sets the spoofed position to your current position.
1282793785.text: 将虚假位置设置为您的当前位置。

1770385198.text: 最大长度为 24 个字符。

400772526.text: 最大长度为 4 个字符。

4222251513.source: Crew ID has to exist for the crew to be displayed. The crew picture is also determined from this ID.
4222251513.text: 必须存在帮会 ID 才能显示帮会。帮会图片也是由该 ID 确定的。

3908263590.source: Will show your crew tag in a square in the player list.
3908263590.text: 将在玩家列表的方框中显示你的帮会标签。

3765094096.source: Spoof your score data for your session.
3765094096.text: 为您的会话伪造得分数据。

4175778269.source: Retrieve the current original score stats if possible.
4175778269.text: 如果可能，读取当前的原始分数统计

2089347071.source: Spoof the rank which other players will see in your session.
2089347071.text: 伪造其他玩家在战局中看到的等级

552483179.source: Spoof the amount of kills you have (affects your K/D).
552483179.text: 伪造你的击杀次数（会影响你的 K/D）。

1370757348.source: Spoof the amount of deaths you have (affects your K/D).
1370757348.text: 伪造你的死亡次数（会影响你的 K/D）。

2412910922.source: Spoof the amount of wallet cash you have. Can only be seen by modders.
2412910922.text: 伪装你的钱包现金数额。只有作弊者能看到。

3816877710.source: Spoof the amount of banked cash you have. Can only be seen by modders.
3816877710.text: 伪造您的银行现金数额。只有修改者才能看到。

1728581435.source: Spoof the amount of sexual acts you performed with a hooker. Can be seen by modders or through a Terrorbyte player scan.
1728581435.text: 伪装你与妓女发生性行为的次数。作弊者或恐霸的玩家扫描功能可以查看。

1059962186.source: Spoof the amount of lap dances you received from a stripper. Can be seen by modders or through a Terrorbyte player scan.
1059962186.text: 伪造你接受脱衣舞娘膝上舞的次数。作弊者或通过恐霸的玩家扫描功能可以看到此数据。

4122208955.text: 适用于所有 行人 的自旋模式t。

3120343568.source: Spinbot for all kinds of objects.
3120343568.text: 适用于各类物体的旋转陀螺。

3145852605.text: 所有拥有的多人车库的列表。

2479604754.source: A list of all saved multiplayer vehicles.
2479604754.text: 所有已保存的多人游戏车辆的列表。

447539156.source: Request the selected vehicle from your garage. This might take a few seconds.
447539156.text: 从车库呼叫所选载具。这可能需要几秒钟。

1875699399.source: Clean up your personal vehicle and put it properly back into the garage.
1875699399.text: 清理你的个人载具并将其妥善放回车库。

2816017279.text: 将当前载具转变为个人载具

268956264.source: Lets you store almost any vehicle in a garage with all its modifications.
268956264.text: 允许你将几乎任何载具及其所有改装部件一并存入车库。

3329531463.source: Deletes the selected vehicle from your garage.
3329531463.text: 从车库中永久删除选定的车辆

3144191338.source: Spawn an exact copy of the current vehicle.

828471125.source: Makes your character unable to fall out of vehicles or bikes.
828471125.text: 使你的角色无法从车辆或自行车上掉下来。

1458836714.source: Make other cars move out of your way as if you had a siren.
1458836714.text: 使其他车辆像听到警报器一样为你让路。

639292904.source: Rewind your drive like in Forza Horizon while you are the driver. Press Left Arrow, or hold LB and press D-Pad Left on a controller, then rewind further, continue from there or cancel.
639292904.text: 当你作为驾驶员时，可以像在 Forza Horizon 中一样倒带行驶。按左方向键，或在手柄上按住 LB 并按十字键左键，即可进一步倒带、从此处继续或取消。

1144811382.source: Increases in-air control and makes performing a wheelie easier.
1144811382.text: 提升空中操控能力，并使翘头动作更容易完成。

2538190953.source: Makes your vehicle fly. Press LEFT CONTROL to go down, SPACE to go up, and WASD to go sideways. Make sure to enable Bypass Max Speed.
2538190953.text: 让你的载具飞行。按左 Ctrl 键下降，按空格键上升，按 WASD 键横向移动。请确保启用“绕过最大速度”。

3775835664.text: 增强 特效 声音

3670421005.source: Boost will be applied as a percentage of your current vehicle speed.
3670421005.text: 相对于当前车速的提升。

833043206.source: Speed up your vehicle while you press the horn.
833043206.text: 按下喇叭时为载具加速。

3039138978.source: Exclude yourself from being kicked from the vehicle.

3643836202.source: Makes your vehicle able to drive underwater.

2429759967.source: Keeps your tyres at their peak grip instead of breaking away into a slide, also in the wet and offroad. Handbrake turns and burnouts still slide, and rally tyres are left as they are.
2429759967.text: 让你的轮胎始终保持最佳抓地力而不会失控打滑，在湿地和越野环境下同样有效。手刹转向和烧胎仍会打滑，拉力轮胎则保持原样。

756387302.source: Makes your car radio sound loud and distorted when heard from outside your vehicle.
756387302.text: 从载具外部听时，使车载收音机的声音变得巨大且失真。

3137651835.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can jump natively like some special vehicles.
3137651835.text: 覆盖载具能力，使其能够像某些特殊载具一样原生跳跃。

220796167.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can parachute natively like a Ruiner 2000.
220796167.text: 覆盖载具能力，使其能够像灭世暴徒 2000 一样原生使用降落伞。

815380858.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can rocket boost natively like some special vehicles.
815380858.text: 覆盖载具能力，使其能够像某些特殊载具一样原生使用火箭推进。

3926100177.source: Overrides the vehicle abilities so it can glide natively like an Oppressor MK1.
3926100177.text: 覆盖载具能力，使其能够像暴君 MK1 一样原生滑翔。

1356298061.source: Allows your vehicle to smash everything with infinite force.

3774393474.source: Disables collision with walls and buildings.
3774393474.text: 禁用与墙壁和建筑物的碰撞

2892289247.source: Disables collision with all other vehicles.

2025031149.source: Disables collision with all kinds of objects.
2025031149.text: 禁用与各类物体的碰撞。

2992054010.source: Disables collision with all other peds.

1096989362.text: 轮胎烟雾颜色闪烁延迟

560511685.source: Measured in kg, mass is only responsible for the interaction between entities. Let's say it's the vehicle's pushing force. The name of this variable in the game files is fMass.
560511685.text: 以 kg 为单位，质量仅负责实体之间的相互作用。可以将其视作载具的推动力。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fMass。

2640041464.source: The vehicle's body air resistance. Higher resistance means an earlier perceived loss of power at higher speed, resulting in a lower top speed, as the engine cannot overpower this force. Lower air resistance allows the vehicle to travel faster on the same power. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDragCoeff.
2640041464.text: 车身空气阻力。阻力越大，高速行驶时感知到的动力损失越早，导致最高车速更低，因为发动机无法克服这一阻力。空气阻力越小，载具在相同动力下的行驶速度越快。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fInitialDragCoeff。

1519782809.source: Downforce is a way to gain grip at speed, and can be increased by spoilers. The name of this variable in the game files is fDownforceModifier.
1519782809.text: 下压力是一种在速度下获得抓地力的方法，可以通过剧透来增加。这个变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fDownforceModifier。

2450987085.source: It dictates the target acceleration the engine is aiming for, measured in G-Forces. Wheel grip may not be able to cope with it, however. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDriveForce.
2450987085.text: 它规定了引擎的目标加速度，以 G 力为单位测量。然而，车轮抓地力可能无法应对它。游戏文件中该变量的名称是 fInitialDriveForce。

684547384.source: How responsive the engine revs will be to throttle control. Higher values will result in faster RPM acceleration and deceleration, while lower values will result in more sluggish RPMs. The name of this variable in the game files is fDriveInertia.
684547384.text: 发动机转速对油门控制的响应灵敏度。数值越高，转速（RPM）的提升和回落越快；数值越低，转速响应越迟钝。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fDriveInertia。

1226758183.source: Top speed on the flat. The name of this variable in the game files is fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel.
1226758183.text: 平地上的最高速度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fInitialDriveMaxFlatVel。

2298505703.source: Higher values will mean faster shifts. The name of this variable in the game files is fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift.
2298505703.text: 较高的值意味着更快的换档。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fClutchChangeRateScaleUpShift。

744861246.source: Higher values will mean faster shifts. The name of this variable in the game files is fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift.
744861246.text: 较高的值意味着更快的换档。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fClutchChangeRateScaleDownShift。

118606586.source: Defines how the power from fInitialDriveForce is distributed between the axles. 0.0 implies a fully RWD setup, which will only deliver power to the rear wheels. The name of this variable in the game files is fDriveBiasFront.
118606586.text: 定义 fInitialDriveForce 的动力在车桥之间的分配比例。0.0 表示纯后驱（RWD）调校，仅向后轮输出动力。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fDriveBiasFront。

4277676405.source: Spring strength. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionForce.
4277676405.text: 弹簧强度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fSuspensionForce。

3109665481.source: How strongly the spring strength is dampened when compressing or decompressing. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionCompDamp.
3109665481.text: 压缩或解压缩时弹簧强度的衰减程度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fSuspensionCompDamp。

4090980881.source: How strongly the spring strength is dampened when compressing or decompressing. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionReboundDamp.
4090980881.text: 压缩或解压缩时弹簧强度的衰减程度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fSuspensionReboundDamp。

4040924339.source: Compression upper limit, in meters. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionUpperLimit.
4040924339.text: 压缩上限，单位为米。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为fSuspensionUpperLimit。

2689192344.source: Compression lower limit, in meters. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionLowerLimit.
2689192344.text: 压缩下限，单位为米。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为fSuspensionLowerLimit。

3102998349.source: In meters, this raises or lowers the natural stance of the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionRaise.
3102998349.text: 以米为单位，这会升高或降低车辆的自然姿态。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fSuspensionRaise。

3378618204.source: Spring strength distribution between the axles of the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSuspensionBiasFront.
3378618204.text: 车辆车轴之间的弹簧强度分布。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fSuspensionBiasFront。

3116600155.source: How strongly the antiroll bars try to keep the vehicle from leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fAntiRollBarForce.
3116600155.text: 防侧倾杆阻止车辆倾斜的强度。游戏文件中该变量的名称是 fAntiRollBarForce。

4275379701.source: Distribution of the antiroll bar strength between the car axles. The name of this variable in the game files is fAntiRollBarBiasFront.
4275379701.text: 车轴之间防侧倾杆强度的分布。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fAntiRollBarBiasFront。

70707008.source: Relative to the model bottom, defines where the pivot point is. This is used for leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fRollCentreHeightFront.
70707008.text: 相对于模型底部，定义枢轴点的位置。这用于倾斜。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fRollCentreHeightFront。

4156467570.source: Relative to the model bottom, defines where the pivot point is. This is used for leaning. The name of this variable in the game files is fRollCentreHeightRear.
4156467570.text: 相对于模型底部，定义枢轴点的位置。这用于倾斜。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fRollCentreHeightRear。

293634038.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fCollisionDamageMult.
293634038.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fCollisionDamageMult。

2210756519.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fWeaponDamageMult.
2210756519.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fWeaponDamageMult。

1220079591.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fDeformationDamageMult.
1220079591.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fDeformationDamageMult。

2351201883.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fEngineDamageMult.
2351201883.text: 游戏文件中该变量的名称是fEngineDamageMult。

3252806329.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fRocketBoostCapacity.
3252806329.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fRocketBoostCapacity。

1900163724.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fBoostMaxSpeed.
1900163724.text: 游戏文件中该变量的名称是fBoostMaxSpeed。

1613318317.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistX.
1613318317.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fSeatOffsetDistX。

2922412633.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistY.
2922412633.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fSeatOffsetDistY。

2288934142.source: The name of this variable in the game files is fSeatOffsetDistZ.
2288934142.text: 该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fSeatOffsetDistZ。

197352248.source: Give your current vehicle the drift handling of the new chop shop drift vehicles.
197352248.text: 为您当前的车辆提供漂移车辆的漂移操控。

1611911543.source: Give your current vehicle the ability to fly like a Deluxo.
1611911543.text: 让你当前的车辆能够像德罗索一样飞行。

3765290531.source: Give your current vehicle the ability to fly like an MK2.
3765290531.text: 赋予当前载具像 MK2 一样飞行的能力。

1478789996.source: A handling file is always associated with a specific vehicle model.
1478789996.text: 载具操控文件始终与特定的载具模型相关联。

2855140870.source: A handling file is always associated with a specific vehicle model.
2855140870.text: 载具操控文件始终与特定的载具模型相关联。

2107224924.source: Reset the handling of your current vehicle to default.
2107224924.text: 将当前车辆的操控重置为默认值。

2169053227.source: Reset the handling of all vehicles to default.
2169053227.text: 将所有车辆的操作重置为默认。

1524355269.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
1524355269.text: 车辆模型信息标志，有多种用途

98675222.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
98675222.text: 车辆模型信息标志，做各种事情

1015251461.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
1015251461.text: 车辆模型信息标志，做各种事情

3174327335.source: Vehicle Model Info Flags that do various things.
3174327335.text: 车辆模型信息标志，做各种事情

746822079.source: How many Gs of deceleration are applied to each wheel. The name of this variable in the game files is fBrakeForce.
746822079.text: 每个轮子有多少G的减速度。这个变量在游戏文件中的名称是fBrakeForce。

3315944485.source: Similar to fBrakeForce, but is only applied to the rear axle(s). The name of this variable in the game files is fHandBrakeForce.
3315944485.text: 与fBrakeForce类似，但仅应用于后轴。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fHandBrakeForce。

2122338454.source: Maximum and minimum G's the vehicle's wheels are able to pull. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveMin.
2122338454.text: 车辆车轮能够拉动的最大和最小 G。这个变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fTractionCurveMin。

3458729118.source: Maximum and minimum G's the vehicle's wheels are able to pull. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveMax.
3458729118.text: 车辆车轮能够拉动的最大和最小 G。这个变量在游戏文件中的名称是 fTractionCurveMax。

285714947.source: Slide angle at which the car will enjoy the best grip available. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionCurveLateral.
285714947.text: 汽车将享受最佳抓地力的滑动角度。游戏文件中该变量的名称是 fTractionCurveLateral。

220317698.source: Very useful for dragsters and high performance cars that come with changes like these. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionBiasFront.
220317698.text: 对于直线加速赛车以及带有此类调校的高性能跑车非常有用。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fTractionBiasFront。

2313844976.source: Scale factor for how fast tyres lose grip. The name of this variable in the game files is fTractionLossMult.
2313844976.text: 轮胎失去抓地力速度的比例因子。游戏文件中该变量的名称是 fTractionLossMult。

2477700197.source: How exaggerated the fake burnout grip loss is for this vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fLowSpeedTractionLossMult.
2477700197.text: 该载具在烧胎时模拟的抓地力损失强度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称为 fLowSpeedTractionLossMult。

2295409652.source: Maximum steering angle for the vehicle. The name of this variable in the game files is fSteeringLock.
2295409652.text: 车辆的最大转向角度。该变量在游戏文件中的名称是fSteeringLock。

2783789550.text: 紧凑型 EMP 发射器

3136862601.source: Allows you to place up to 255 C4 at once.
3136862601.text: 允许您一次放置最多 255 个 C4。

3082981980.text: 允许车内使用所有武器

157106628.source: You will be able to pick any weapon from your weapon wheel while inside a vehicle. Warning: This will break normal vehicle weapons like turrets.
157106628.text: 你将能够在载具内从武器轮盘中选择任意武器。警告：这将破坏炮塔等常规载具武器的功能。

2938763818.source: Allows you to use all weapons in interiors.
2938763818.text: 允许你在室内使用所有武器。

4105025411.text: 在载具内保持消音器开启

1386933639.source: Instantly lock on to your targets whether on foot or in a vehicle.
